dashboard.title: Match Stoplight
dashboard.description: Stoplight health metrics stay pinned to the latest log session for the selected event/match.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM metrics WHERE regexp_replace(file_name, '\.[0-9]+\.wpilog$', '.wpilog') = (CASE WHEN '${log_session}' = '__latest__' THEN (
SELECT regexp_replace(file_name, '\.[0-9]+\.wpilog$', '.wpilog') AS log_session
FROM metrics
WHERE event_key = (CASE WHEN '${event_key}' = '__latest__' THEN (
SELECT event_key
FROM metrics
WHERE file_name NOT LIKE '%_rio_%'
    AND LOWER(file_name) NOT LIKE 'rio_%'
        AND LOWER(event_key) != 'off-field'
GROUP BY event_key
ORDER BY MAX(COALESCE(log_timestamp, metric_timestamp)) DESC
LIMIT 1
) ELSE '${event_key}' END)
    AND match_info = (CASE WHEN '${match_info}' = '__latest__' THEN (
SELECT match_info
FROM metrics
WHERE event_key = (CASE WHEN '${event_key}' = '__latest__' THEN (
SELECT event_key
FROM metrics
WHERE file_name NOT LIKE '%_rio_%'
    AND LOWER(file_name) NOT LIKE 'rio_%'
        AND LOWER(event_key) != 'off-field'
GROUP BY event_key
ORDER BY MAX(COALESCE(log_timestamp, metric_timestamp)) DESC
LIMIT 1
) ELSE '${event_key}' END)
    AND file_name NOT LIKE '%_rio_%'
    AND LOWER(file_name) NOT LIKE 'rio_%'
GROUP BY match_info
ORDER BY MAX(COALESCE(log_timestamp, metric_timestamp)) DESC
LIMIT 1
) ELSE '${match_info}' END)
    AND file_name NOT LIKE '%_rio_%'
    AND LOWER(file_name) NOT LIKE 'rio_%'
GROUP BY log_session
ORDER BY MAX(COALESCE(log_timestamp, metric_timestamp)) DESC
LIMIT 1
) ELSE '${log_session}' END) AND stoplight >= 1;
